definition_zh: 病历各项文书齐全、内容完整无缺项的状态
definition_en: The state in which all required documents and contents are present without gaps.
source_file: 医疗机构病历管理规定

definition_zh: 规定哪些人员可在何种范围内查阅病历的授权规则
definition_en: The rules defining who may view records and within what scope.
source_file: 医疗机构病历管理规定；电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 集中存放与管理病历档案的部门与场所
definition_en: The department and premises where records are stored and managed.
source_file: 医疗机构病历管理规定

definition_zh: 以电子形式创建、保存与使用的患者诊疗记录
definition_en: A patient care record created, stored and used in electronic form.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范；病历书写基本规范

definition_zh: 以电子形式附着于病历、用于确认签署人身份的签名
definition_en: An electronic mark attached to the record that confirms the identity of the signer.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 通过证书或密码验证电子签名真实性与归属的过程
definition_en: The process of verifying the authenticity and ownership of an electronic signature.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 由系统自动记录的操作时刻，用于证明记录形成时间
definition_en: The time automatically recorded by the system to prove when a record was created.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 支持病历录入、存储、查询与共享的信息系统
definition_en: The information system supporting entry, storage, retrieval and sharing of records.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 按预设字段与选项录入、便于统计分析的病历形式
definition_en: A record entered through predefined fields and options so that it can be analysed.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 预先设置好栏目与常用表述、供快速书写的病历框架
definition_en: A preset framework of sections and standard wording for faster documentation.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范；病历书写基本规范

definition_zh: 系统保留的病历历次修改内容、时间与操作者记录
definition_en: The system's record of each change to a document with content, time and user.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范；医疗机构病历管理规定

definition_zh: 系统对登录、查询与修改等操作的行为记录
definition_en: The system's log of actions such as logging in, viewing and editing.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 将完成的电子病历锁定并转入归档库的过程
definition_en: Locking a completed electronic record and moving it into the archive.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范；医疗机构病历管理规定

definition_zh: 在不同机构或系统之间按授权调阅病历数据
definition_en: Access to record data across institutions or systems under the patient's authorisation.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 保护病历数据不被泄露、篡改或丢失的技术与管理措施
definition_en: Technical and managerial measures protecting record data from disclosure, alteration or loss.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 按功能与应用水平对医院电子病历系统进行的等级评定
definition_en: A level assessment of hospital electronic record systems by function and use.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 不同系统之间按标准交换数据的连接方式
definition_en: The connection by which different systems exchange data according to a standard.
source_file: 电子病历应用管理规范

definition_zh: 切除病变阑尾的手术，多用于急性阑尾炎及反复发作的阑尾炎
definition_en: Surgical removal of the appendix, most often for acute or recurrent appendicitis.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；病历书写基本规范

definition_zh: 经腹腔镜完成阑尾切除的微创术式，腹壁仅留穿刺孔
definition_en: Removal of the appendix through laparoscopic ports, leaving only small abdominal puncture wounds.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 切开腹壁与子宫娩出胎儿的手术，用于难产、胎儿窘迫等情况
definition_en: Delivery of a fetus through incisions in the abdominal wall and uterus, used for obstructed labour or fetal distress.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 清除伤口内坏死组织与异物后缝合创口的处理，用于开放性伤口
definition_en: Cleaning out necrotic tissue and debris from a wound and then closing it, used for open wounds.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

definition_zh: 用钢板、螺钉或髓内钉等内固定物稳定骨折端的手术
definition_en: Surgery that stabilises the fractured bone ends with plates, screws or intramedullary nails.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 经腹腔镜进入腹腔直视探查、必要时同期处理的术式
definition_en: A minimally invasive procedure using a laparoscope to inspect the abdomen and treat findings at the same time.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 切除病变胆囊的手术，常用于胆囊结石与急性胆囊炎
definition_en: Surgical removal of the gallbladder, usually for gallstones or acute cholecystitis.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 还纳疝内容物并修补腹股沟管后壁的手术
definition_en: Surgery that returns the hernia contents and repairs the posterior wall of the inguinal canal.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 切除胃远端大部并重建消化道的术式，用于溃疡并发症或肿瘤
definition_en: Removal of most of the distal stomach with reconstruction, used for complicated ulcers or tumours.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 切除病变肠段后将两断端重新吻合的手术
definition_en: Removal of a diseased segment of bowel followed by joining the two healthy ends together.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 经胸壁置管引流胸腔积气或积液的治疗性操作
definition_en: Insertion of a chest tube through the chest wall to drain air or fluid from the pleural space.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 切除病变或坏死肢体以保全生命的手术
definition_en: Surgical removal of a diseased or necrotic limb to preserve life.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 用人工关节替换病变髋关节以恢复行走功能的手术
definition_en: Replacement of the diseased hip joint with a prosthesis to restore walking ability.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 用自体血管在狭窄冠状动脉两端搭桥以改善心肌供血的手术
definition_en: Bypass surgery using a harvested vessel graft to restore blood flow beyond a narrowed coronary artery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 切除皮肤或皮下肿物并送病理检查的小手术
definition_en: Removal of a skin or subcutaneous lump, with the specimen sent for pathological examination.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 切开脓肿排出脓液并放置引流条的手术
definition_en: Cutting open an abscess to release pus and placing a drain.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

definition_zh: 全身麻醉后置入气管导管控制通气的麻醉方式
definition_en: General anesthesia in which a tracheal tube is placed to control ventilation during surgery.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 全部麻醉药经静脉持续泵入、不使用吸入麻醉药的全身麻醉
definition_en: General anesthesia maintained entirely by intravenous infusion without inhalational agents.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 以挥发性麻醉气体经呼吸道吸入维持的全身麻醉
definition_en: General anesthesia maintained by volatile anesthetic gases inhaled through the airway.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 把局麻药注入椎管内阻断脊神经传导的区域麻醉，含腰麻与硬膜外
definition_en: Regional anesthesia produced by injecting local anesthetic into the spinal canal to block nerve conduction.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 把局麻药注入蛛网膜下腔产生快速阻滞的麻醉方式，俗称腰麻
definition_en: Injection of local anesthetic into the subarachnoid space to produce rapid surgical anesthesia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 把局麻药注入硬膜外腔、可置管持续给药的麻醉方式
definition_en: Injection of local anesthetic into the epidural space, often with a catheter for continuous dosing.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 先穿刺蛛网膜下腔给药、再置入硬膜外导管的联合麻醉技术
definition_en: A technique combining a spinal injection for rapid onset with an epidural catheter for extension.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 沿手术切口分层注射局麻药以阻滞末梢神经的方法
definition_en: Layer-by-layer injection of local anesthetic along the planned incision to block terminal nerve endings.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 把局麻药注射到神经干或神经丛周围以阻断其支配区域感觉的方法
definition_en: Injection of local anesthetic around a nerve or plexus to block sensation in the area it supplies.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 在上肢手术中于臂丛周围注药、阻滞整个上肢感觉与运动的麻醉
definition_en: Local anesthetic deposited around the brachial plexus to block sensation and movement of the upper limb.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 把局麻药涂布或喷雾于黏膜表面以产生局部无痛的麻醉
definition_en: Application of local anesthetic to a mucosal surface by spray or gel to produce local numbness.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 麻醉医师监护下给予镇静镇痛、患者保留自主呼吸的麻醉方式
definition_en: Sedation and analgesia provided under an anesthesiologist's monitoring while spontaneous breathing is maintained.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 用药物减轻焦虑与不适、按深度分为轻度至深度镇静的状态
definition_en: Drug-induced reduction of anxiety and discomfort, graded from minimal to deep sedation.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 患者意识保留、能应答指令的镇静状态，常用于短小操作
definition_en: A sedated state in which the patient remains conscious and able to respond to commands.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 从清醒状态转为可手术麻醉状态的给药过程
definition_en: The process of taking a patient from the awake state to a depth of anesthesia suitable for surgery.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术期间持续给药以保持适当麻醉深度的阶段
definition_en: The period during surgery in which anesthesia is kept at an adequate depth by continuous dosing.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 麻醉医师在术前到病房访视患者、交代麻醉方案与风险的过程
definition_en: The anesthesiologist's bedside visit before surgery to review the patient and explain the anesthetic plan and risks.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；病历书写基本规范

definition_zh: 麻醉前对心肺功能、气道与用药情况的专项评估
definition_en: A focused evaluation of cardiac, pulmonary, airway and medication status before anesthesia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术前按需完成的化验、影像与功能检查组合
definition_en: The set of laboratory, imaging and functional tests required before an operation.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 评估心脏泵血与肺通气换气能力能否耐受手术与麻醉
definition_en: Assessment of whether cardiac output and pulmonary gas exchange can withstand surgery and anesthesia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术前记录心电活动、用于筛查心律失常与心肌缺血的检查
definition_en: A tracing of cardiac electrical activity before surgery, used to detect arrhythmia or myocardial ischaemia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 反映肝脏代谢与肾脏排泄能力的化验组合，用于调整麻醉用药
definition_en: Laboratory tests of hepatic metabolism and renal excretion, used to adjust anesthetic drugs.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 测定血钾、钠、氯、钙等浓度、评估内环境稳定性的化验
definition_en: Measurement of serum potassium, sodium, chloride and calcium to assess internal milieu stability.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 术前按药物半衰期提前停用抗凝药以降低出血风险的措施
definition_en: Stopping anticoagulants a set interval before surgery, based on drug half-life, to reduce bleeding risk.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 手术前至少四周停止吸烟以降低呼吸道并发症的措施
definition_en: Stopping smoking at least four weeks before surgery to reduce respiratory complications.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 评估患者营养状态与手术耐受力、决定营养支持方案的检查
definition_en: Assessment of nutritional status and surgical reserve to decide on nutritional support.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 患者日常活动与运动耐量水平，是预测围术期风险的重要指标
definition_en: The patient's daily activity and exercise tolerance, an important predictor of perioperative risk.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术科室与麻醉、护理等共同讨论手术方案与风险的会议
definition_en: A meeting of the surgical team with anesthesia and nursing to agree the operative plan and risks.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 颈椎前屈后伸与旋转的范围，影响插管时的头位摆放
definition_en: The range of cervical flexion, extension and rotation that affects head positioning for intubation.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 牙齿松动、缺失或修复体情况，关系到喉镜置入与牙损伤风险
definition_en: The state of the teeth, including looseness, missing teeth and dental work, affecting laryngoscopy and dental injury risk.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 可自行摘戴的假牙，麻醉前须取下以免脱落堵塞气道
definition_en: A denture that can be taken out, which must be removed before anesthesia to prevent airway obstruction.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 需要多次尝试或借助特殊器械才能完成气管插管的情形
definition_en: A situation requiring multiple attempts or special equipment to place a tracheal tube.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 按喉镜下所见声门结构显露程度分四级的评估方法
definition_en: A four-grade classification of how much of the glottis is visible at laryngoscopy.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 睡眠时上气道反复塌陷导致呼吸暂停与低氧的疾病
definition_en: Repeated upper airway collapse during sleep causing apnoeas and intermittent hypoxaemia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 下颌骨下缘与舌骨之间的软组织间隙，评估插管条件的三指指标之一
definition_en: The soft tissue space between the mandible and hyoid, one of the three-finger indices of intubation conditions.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 麻醉诱导前给予纯氧以提高体内氧储备、延长无通气安全时限
definition_en: Administering oxygen before induction to build oxygen reserves and lengthen the safe apnoea time.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 饱胃或误吸高风险患者快速给药并立即插管的诱导方法
definition_en: An induction technique for patients at high aspiration risk, using rapid drug delivery and immediate intubation.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 按步骤选择插管、声门上气道与外科气道的结构化预案
definition_en: A structured plan that steps through intubation, supraglottic rescue and surgical airway.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 除手术疾病外无系统性疾病、身体健康的患者分级
definition_en: The class for a healthy patient with no systemic disease beyond the surgical condition.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 合并轻度系统性疾病、日常活动不受限的患者分级
definition_en: The class for a patient with mild systemic disease that does not limit daily activity.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 合并中重度系统性疾病、日常活动受限的患者分级
definition_en: The class for a patient with moderate to severe systemic disease that limits activity.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 合并危及生命的重度系统性疾病、持续威胁生存的患者分级
definition_en: The class for a patient with severe systemic disease that is a constant threat to life.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 濒死状态、预计不手术难以存活的患者分级
definition_en: The class for a moribund patient not expected to survive without the operation.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 已宣告脑死亡、器官捐献取器官的患者分级
definition_en: The class for a patient declared brain-dead whose organs are being removed for donation.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；人体器官捐献和移植条例

definition_zh: 在 ASA 分级后加 E，表示急诊手术、风险高于同期择期手术
definition_en: The letter E added to an ASA class to show emergency surgery, which carries higher risk than elective cases.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 依据 ASA 分级与手术类型综合判断麻醉风险高低的分层方法
definition_en: A stratification of anesthetic risk derived from the ASA class together with the type of surgery.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 从手术前到术后一段时间内发生并发症或死亡的综合风险
definition_en: The combined risk of complications or death from the period before surgery through recovery.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 患者承受手术创伤、麻醉与失血打击的能力
definition_en: The patient's ability to withstand surgical trauma, anesthesia and blood loss.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 手术前两小时起停止饮用清饮料的禁饮要求
definition_en: The requirement to stop clear fluids two hours before anesthesia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 从最后一次进食到麻醉开始之间的小时数
definition_en: The number of hours between the last intake and the start of anesthesia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 清水、无果肉果汁与含糖饮料等麻醉前两小时仍可饮用的液体
definition_en: Water, pulp-free juice and sugary drinks that may still be taken up to two hours before anesthesia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 胃内容物排空时间延长、麻醉时误吸风险升高的状态
definition_en: Prolonged retention of gastric contents, which raises the risk of aspiration during anesthesia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术前清洁肠道、减少肠内容物的准备措施
definition_en: Measures to clear the bowel and reduce its contents before abdominal surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 手术前清洁手术区域皮肤、减少切口感染的操作
definition_en: Cleaning the skin over the operative site to reduce the risk of wound infection.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

definition_zh: 在手术切口周围去除毛发、便于消毒与缝合的准备步骤
definition_en: Removal of hair around the incision to allow antisepsis and closure.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

definition_zh: 麻醉前按医嘱给予的镇静、镇痛或抗胆碱药物
definition_en: Drugs such as sedatives, analgesics or anticholinergics given by order before anesthesia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 手术前为减轻焦虑而给予的短效镇静处理
definition_en: Short-acting sedation given before surgery to relieve anxiety and improve cooperation at induction.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 切皮前规定时间内给予、用于降低手术部位感染的抗菌药物
definition_en: An antimicrobial given within a set time before incision to reduce surgical site infection.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；抗菌药物临床应用指导原则

definition_zh: 停用长期抗凝药期间用短效抗凝药过渡、防止血栓的措施
definition_en: Using a short-acting anticoagulant while a long-term agent is stopped, to prevent thrombosis.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 手术前后监测并调控血糖、减少高血糖与低血糖风险的措施
definition_en: Monitoring and adjusting blood glucose around surgery to limit hyperglycaemia and hypoglycaemia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 胃内容物或口腔分泌物进入下呼吸道造成损伤的并发症
definition_en: Entry of gastric contents or oral secretions into the lower airway, causing injury.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 麻醉结束后超过预期时间仍未恢复意识的状态
definition_en: Failure to regain consciousness within the expected time after anesthesia ends.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 挥发性麻醉药或琥珀胆碱诱发的遗传性高热与肌肉强直危象
definition_en: A inherited hyperthermic crisis with muscle rigidity triggered by volatile agents or succinylcholine.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 局麻药误入血管或过量引起的中枢神经与心脏毒性反应
definition_en: Central nervous and cardiac toxicity from inadvertent intravascular injection or an excessive dose of local anesthetic.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 硬膜外或腰麻时局麻药大量进入蛛网膜下腔导致的全脊髓阻滞
definition_en: Extensive spinal block caused by a large dose of local anesthetic entering the subarachnoid space.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 硬膜穿破后脑脊液外漏引起的体位性头痛
definition_en: A postural headache caused by cerebrospinal fluid leak after dural puncture.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 麻醉穿刺或体位压迫造成的周围神经感觉或运动障碍
definition_en: Sensory or motor impairment of a peripheral nerve caused by needle trauma or positioning pressure.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 气道平滑肌强烈收缩导致呼气困难与气道压升高的麻醉并发症
definition_en: Severe airway smooth muscle contraction causing expiratory difficulty and rising airway pressure.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 全身麻醉中患者恢复意识并能回忆手术过程的现象
definition_en: A phenomenon in which a patient regains consciousness during general anesthesia and recalls the surgery.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 麻醉与手术后出现的恶心和呕吐，是常见的不适并发症
definition_en: Nausea and vomiting after anesthesia and surgery, a common and distressing complication.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 对麻醉药物产生的免疫介导反应，轻者皮疹重者过敏性休克
definition_en: An immune-mediated reaction to anesthetic drugs, from rash to anaphylactic shock.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 麻醉与手术期间血压低于维持器官灌注所需水平的状态
definition_en: Blood pressure during anesthesia and surgery that falls below the level needed for organ perfusion.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 麻醉药物残余作用导致呼吸频率或潮气量不足的状态
definition_en: Insufficient respiratory rate or tidal volume from residual anesthetic drug effect.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 神经阻滞或椎管内麻醉未能达到预期麻醉效果的情形
definition_en: A regional or neuraxial block that fails to produce the intended anesthetic effect.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 麻醉实施过程中出现的各类不良事件总称
definition_en: Any adverse event that arises during the delivery of anesthesia and must be documented.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；病历书写基本规范

definition_zh: 麻醉苏醒阶段出现的烦躁、挣扎与不配合状态
definition_en: Restlessness, thrashing and non-cooperation during emergence from general anesthesia after surgery.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术过程中与术后可能出现的并发症、伤残与死亡风险
definition_en: The risk of complications, disability or death during and after an operation.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；民法典（医疗损害责任编）

definition_zh: 手术过程中组织或血管损伤导致的失血
definition_en: Blood loss from tissue or vessel injury during an operation.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 手术结束后切口或创面再次出血的并发症
definition_en: Renewed bleeding from the wound or operative bed after surgery has finished.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 发生于切口或手术深部组织的感染，多在术后数日至数周出现
definition_en: Infection of the incision or deeper operative tissues, appearing days to weeks after surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

definition_zh: 下肢深静脉内形成的血栓，术后活动减少时风险升高
definition_en: A clot forming in a deep leg vein, with higher risk when mobility is reduced after surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 手术操作造成的动脉或静脉破裂、狭窄或血栓形成
definition_en: Rupture, narrowing or thrombosis of an artery or vein caused during surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 手术中邻近器官被误伤造成的穿孔、破裂或功能障碍
definition_en: Accidental damage to adjacent organs during surgery, causing perforation, rupture or dysfunction.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 手术后组织修复过程中形成的异常纤维连接，可致肠梗阻
definition_en: Abnormal fibrous bands formed during healing after surgery, which can cause bowel obstruction.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 切口愈合缓慢或愈合质量差、延迟拆线的状态
definition_en: Slow or inadequate healing of an incision that delays suture removal.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 手术前至术后三十天内发生的死亡
definition_en: Death occurring between the preoperative period and thirty days after surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；民法典（医疗损害责任编）

definition_zh: 短时间内失血量超过循环代偿能力的大出血
definition_en: Rapid blood loss during surgery that exceeds the circulation's ability to compensate.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 手术未能达到预期治疗目标或未能解除病变
definition_en: An operation that fails to achieve the intended goal or to remove the pathology.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 手术后原病变在同一部位或器官再次出现
definition_en: Return of the original disease at the same site or organ after surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 术后一个或多个器官功能严重受损、需支持治疗的状态
definition_en: Severe impairment of one or more organs after surgery that requires organ support.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 因并发症或恢复缓慢导致住院天数超过预期
definition_en: A hospital stay longer than expected because of complications or slow recovery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；病历书写基本规范

definition_zh: 除拟行手术外可供选择的保守、药物或介入等治疗方式
definition_en: A conservative, medical or interventional option other than the proposed operation.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 医务人员说明病情、风险与替代方案后患者作出的明确同意
definition_en: The patient's clear agreement after being told the condition, risks and alternatives.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 记录手术名称、风险、替代方案与患者签字的法律文书
definition_en: The legal document recording the procedure, its risks, alternatives and the patient's signature.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 记录麻醉方式、风险与替代选择并由患者签署的文书
definition_en: The document recording the anesthetic plan, its risks and alternatives, signed by the patient.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 不做手术、以药物、休息与观察为主的治疗方式
definition_en: Treatment without surgery that relies on drugs, rest and careful observation.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；民法典（医疗损害责任编）

definition_zh: 以药物控制病情、暂不手术的治疗选择
definition_en: Controlling the condition with drugs instead of operating for now.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 在影像引导下经导管或穿刺完成治疗、创伤小于开放手术的方式
definition_en: Image-guided treatment through catheters or needles, less invasive than open surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；民法典（医疗损害责任编）

definition_zh: 经内镜在腔道内完成切除、止血或引流等治疗的方式
definition_en: Treatment such as resection, haemostasis or drainage performed through an endoscope.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；民法典（医疗损害责任编）

definition_zh: 就同一病情向另一位医师或机构征询的独立诊疗意见
definition_en: An independent opinion on the same condition from another doctor or institution.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 患者在知情后明确不接受手术治疗的决定
definition_en: A patient's decision, after being informed, not to undergo the operation.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 患者在手术实施前取消先前作出的同意决定
definition_en: The patient cancelling a previously given consent before the operation starts.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 患者书面授权他人代为行使知情同意与签字权利的文书
definition_en: A written document by which the patient authorises another person to give consent and sign on their behalf.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

en: person without capacity for civil conduct
definition_zh: 不能辨认自己行为、须由法定代理人代为实施民事法律行为的成年人
definition_en: An adult unable to recognise their own conduct, whose legal representative acts for them in civil matters.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 医疗机构及其医务人员因过错造成患者损害应承担的民事责任
definition_en: Civil liability of a medical institution and its staff for harm caused by fault.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 向患者说明诊疗风险、发生概率与应对措施的过程
definition_en: Explaining to the patient the risks of treatment, how likely they are and how they would be managed.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 术前或治疗前完成血型鉴定与交叉配血并预留血液的措施
definition_en: Blood typing and crossmatching done in advance so units are reserved for possible use.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 记录输血必要性、风险与替代方案并由患者签署的文书
definition_en: The document recording the need for transfusion, its risks and alternatives, signed by the patient.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范；民法典（医疗损害责任编）

definition_zh: 采集患者自身血液在术中或术后回输的输血方式
definition_en: Collecting and returning the patient's own blood during or after surgery.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 把术中失血回收、洗涤后回输给患者的血液保护技术
definition_en: Collecting shed blood during surgery, washing it and returning it to the patient.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 按需分别输注红细胞、血浆或血小板的输血方式
definition_en: Transfusing red cells, plasma or platelets separately according to need.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 采血后六小时内冰冻保存、含全部凝血因子的血浆制品
definition_en: Plasma frozen within six hours of collection and containing all clotting factors.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 去除大部分血浆后的红细胞制品，用于纠正贫血与失血
definition_en: Red cells with most plasma removed, used to correct anaemia and blood loss.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 输注血小板制品以纠正血小板减少或功能障碍的治疗
definition_en: Transfusion of platelet concentrates to correct thrombocytopenia or platelet dysfunction.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 输血过程中或输血后出现发热、过敏、溶血等不良反应
definition_en: An adverse response such as fever, allergy or haemolysis during or after transfusion.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 经血液制品传播的病毒、细菌或寄生虫感染
definition_en: Infection with viruses, bacteria or parasites transmitted through blood products.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范；中华人民共和国传染病防治法

definition_zh: 短时间内输入大量血液制品以抢救大出血的方案
definition_en: A protocol delivering large volumes of blood products quickly to treat major haemorrhage.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 根据血红蛋白、出血速度与临床症状判断需要输血的标准
definition_en: The criteria, based on haemoglobin, bleeding rate and symptoms, that justify transfusion.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 采用较低血红蛋白阈值、减少不必要输血的策略
definition_en: A strategy using a lower haemoglobin threshold to reduce unnecessary transfusion.
source_file: 临床输血技术规范

definition_zh: 手术后为控制切口与内脏疼痛而采取的药物与非药物措施
definition_en: Drug and non-drug measures used to control wound and visceral pain after surgery.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 用评分工具定期评估术后疼痛强度与缓解情况
definition_en: Regular measurement of pain intensity and relief after surgery using a scoring tool.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 按疼痛程度与手术类型制定的给药种类、途径与时间安排
definition_en: The choice of drugs, route and timing set according to pain level and operation type.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 联合使用不同作用机制的镇痛药与技术以提高效果并减少副作用
definition_en: Combining analgesics and techniques with different mechanisms to improve relief and reduce side effects.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 由患者按需自行按压给药泵、实现个体化镇痛的装置与方法
definition_en: A pump system that lets the patient self-administer set doses of analgesic on demand.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 经硬膜外导管持续或间断注入局麻药与阿片类药物的镇痛方式
definition_en: Analgesia delivered through an epidural catheter using local anesthetic with or without an opioid.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 经留置导管持续输注局麻药以延长区域镇痛时间的技术
definition_en: Continuous infusion of local anesthetic through a placed catheter to extend regional analgesia.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 作用于阿片受体、用于中重度疼痛的镇痛药物总称
definition_en: A class of analgesics acting on opioid receptors, used for moderate to severe pain.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 通过抑制环氧化酶发挥解热镇痛抗炎作用的药物，可减少阿片用量
definition_en: A drug that inhibits cyclooxygenase to relieve pain and inflammation and spare opioid use.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 常用解热镇痛药，是术后多模式镇痛的基础药物之一
definition_en: A common analgesic and antipyretic, one of the foundation drugs in multimodal postoperative analgesia.
source_file: 药品说明书（国家药监局核准）；中华人民共和国药典（2020 年版）

definition_zh: 疼痛评分持续偏高、现有镇痛方案未能有效缓解的状态
definition_en: Persistently high pain scores or distress despite the analgesia plan currently in use.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 镇痛镇静药物过量导致嗜睡、唤不醒或呼吸变慢的状态
definition_en: Excessive drowsiness, difficulty rousing or slow breathing from too much sedative or opioid.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 按设定速度或患者按需给药的便携式镇痛输注装置
definition_en: A portable infusion device delivering analgesia at a set rate or on patient demand.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；高警示药品与用药安全专家共识

definition_zh: 手术后患者苏醒与早期监护的专门区域
definition_en: A dedicated area where patients recover from anesthesia and are monitored in the early postoperative period.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 麻醉药物作用消退、患者逐步恢复意识与保护性反射的过程
definition_en: The process in which anesthetic effects wane and consciousness and protective reflexes return.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术后对生命体征、意识、引流量与切口的持续观察
definition_en: Continuous observation of vital signs, consciousness, drain output and the wound after surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术结束、麻醉减浅后撤除气管导管的操作
definition_en: Removal of the tracheal tube once surgery is finished and anesthesia is lightened.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 术后核心体温低于三十六度、影响凝血与苏醒的状态
definition_en: A core temperature below thirty-six degrees after surgery, impairing coagulation and recovery.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 麻醉后出现的骨骼肌不自主收缩，增加耗氧与疼痛
definition_en: Involuntary muscle contraction after anesthesia that increases oxygen consumption and pain.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术后膀胱不能自行排空、残余尿量增多的状态
definition_en: Failure of the bladder to empty after surgery, with a raised residual volume.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术后出现的急性注意力与认知障碍，多见于老年患者
definition_en: Acute disturbance of attention and cognition after surgery, most common in older patients.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 术后尽早下床或床上活动以预防血栓与肺部并发症的措施
definition_en: Getting the patient moving, in or out of bed, soon after surgery to prevent clots and chest complications.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 手术后根据胃肠功能恢复情况重新开始经口进食
definition_en: Restarting food by mouth after surgery once gastrointestinal function returns.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 术后对引流管位置、通畅度与引流液的观察与维护
definition_en: Observing and maintaining drain position, patency and output after surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；病历书写基本规范

definition_zh: 出院后按计划复诊、评估伤口与功能恢复的过程
definition_en: Scheduled review after discharge to assess the wound and functional recovery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 患者当日入院、手术并在二十四小时内出院的择期手术模式
definition_en: Elective surgery in which the patient is admitted, operated and discharged within twenty-four hours.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 专门收治日间手术患者、承担术前准备与术后观察的单元
definition_en: A unit that admits day-surgery patients and handles preparation and short postoperative observation.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 在门诊手术室完成、不需住院的小型手术
definition_en: Minor surgery performed in an outpatient theatre without admission to hospital.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 手术当天完成观察与评估后办理出院
definition_en: Discharge on the same day after observation and assessment following surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 需在一定时限内完成、不宜长期等待的手术
definition_en: Surgery that must be done within a defined time window and should not be deferred for long.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 按分级管理要求由科室与医务部门审核同意实施手术的流程
definition_en: The process of obtaining departmental and medical affairs approval before surgery under grading rules.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 抢救生命垂危患者等紧急情况下无法取得患方意见时经批准立即实施的医疗措施
definition_en: Immediate treatment given in a life-threatening emergency when the patient's views cannot be obtained, after approval.
source_file: 民法典（医疗损害责任编）；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 从决定手术到实际切皮之间的时间间隔
definition_en: The interval between the decision to operate and the actual start of surgery.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 已排定的手术因病情、资源或患者原因临时停止
definition_en: A scheduled operation stopped at short notice because of the condition, resources or the patient.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 在已排满的手术表中临时插入的急诊手术
definition_en: An emergency operation inserted into an already full theatre list.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 按手术分级、资源与紧急程度安排手术间与时间的管理工作
definition_en: Managing theatre rooms and times according to grade, resources and urgency.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 在首次手术时即已拟定、按计划择期实施的再次手术
definition_en: A second operation decided at the first surgery and performed electively as planned.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 首次手术后按计划或疑有并发症时再次开腹探查
definition_en: Returning to the abdomen after a first operation, either as planned or for suspected complications.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 腹腔镜手术中因出血、粘连或暴露困难改为开腹完成手术
definition_en: Changing from laparoscopic to open surgery because of bleeding, adhesions or poor exposure.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 区域麻醉效果不足或患者不能配合时改为全身麻醉
definition_en: Changing from regional to general anesthesia when the block fails or the patient cannot cooperate.
source_file: 麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级；手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 首次手术后因出血、感染或吻合口瘘等并发症而再次手术
definition_en: A second operation after the first, caused by complications such as bleeding, infection or anastomotic leak.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 根据病情判断必须再次手术的临床依据
definition_en: The clinical grounds showing that a further operation is necessary.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 出院后因同一疾病或并发症再次住院
definition_en: Admission again after discharge for the same condition or a complication.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 腹腔镜或区域麻醉改行开放手术或全身麻醉的比例
definition_en: The proportion of laparoscopic or regional cases converted to open surgery or general anesthesia.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

definition_zh: 术中判断是否改变既定术式或麻醉方式的决定过程
definition_en: The intraoperative decision on whether to change the planned procedure or anesthetic.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理；麻醉学指南与 ASA 分级

definition_zh: 再次手术面临的更高出血、感染与器官损伤风险
definition_en: The higher risk of bleeding, infection and organ injury associated with another operation.
source_file: 手术安全核查制度与手术分级管理

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 法律规定的必须报告和管理的传染病，共分甲乙丙三类
definition_en: Infectious diseases that must by law be reported and managed, classified as Class A, B and C.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；病历书写基本规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 传染性强、危害严重、依法采取强制管理措施的传染病，如鼠疫与霍乱
definition_en: Infectious diseases of high transmissibility and severity, such as plague and cholera, managed with compulsory measures.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 危害较大、依法严格管理的传染病，如肺结核、艾滋病与病毒性肝炎
definition_en: Infectious diseases of significant harm that are strictly managed, such as tuberculosis, HIV and viral hepatitis.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 危害相对较轻、依法监测管理的传染病，如流感与手足口病
definition_en: Infectious diseases of relatively lower severity managed through surveillance, such as influenza and hand, foot and mouth disease.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

en: Law on Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 规定传染病预防、报告、控制与救治责任的国家法律
definition_en: The national law that sets duties for the prevention, reporting, control and treatment of infectious diseases.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

en: managed as a Class A disease
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对特定乙类传染病采取甲类传染病预防控制措施的管理方式
definition_en: A management approach applying Class A prevention and control measures to specified Class B diseases.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

en: Class B disease under Class B measures
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对特定传染病采取与乙类传染病相同的预防控制措施的管理方式
definition_en: Management of a specified infectious disease using the prevention and control measures applied to Class B diseases.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 国境卫生检疫法律规定必须实施检疫的传染病
definition_en: Infectious diseases that must be quarantined under frontier health quarantine law.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 国境检疫中需登记并监测、但不必强制隔离的传染病
definition_en: Infectious diseases that are registered and monitored at borders but do not require compulsory isolation.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 新出现或发病率快速上升、人群普遍缺乏免疫力的传染病
definition_en: An infectious disease that has newly appeared or is rising rapidly, with little population immunity.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 发病率曾大幅下降后又重新上升的传染病，如结核与麻疹
definition_en: An infectious disease whose incidence fell markedly and then rose again, such as tuberculosis or measles.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 由境外输入、本地原本无流行或已消除的传染病
definition_en: An infectious disease introduced from abroad into an area where it was absent or eliminated.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 在本地感染、无明确境外或外地暴露史的病例
definition_en: A case infected locally without a clear history of exposure outside the area.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 短时间内同一场所或人群中出现多例关联病例的情况
definition_en: The occurrence of several linked cases in one setting or group within a short period.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 某地区短时间内病例数明显超过常年水平的情况
definition_en: A situation in which cases in an area clearly exceed the usual level within a short time.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 一种传染病在全球多个国家同时广泛传播的状态
definition_en: A state in which an infectious disease spreads widely across many countries at the same time.
source_file: 国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 医务人员发现法定传染病后依法向疾控机构报告的过程
definition_en: The process by which clinicians report notifiable infectious diseases to disease control authorities.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；病历书写基本规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 甲类及按甲类管理传染病须在两小时内完成的报告要求
definition_en: The requirement to report Class A and similarly managed diseases within two hours.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 乙类与丙类传染病应在二十四小时内完成的报告要求
definition_en: The requirement to report Class B and Class C diseases within twenty-four hours.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 通过传染病网络直报系统直接上传个案信息的报告方式
definition_en: Reporting individual cases directly through the national online infectious disease reporting system.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 记录病例基本信息、诊断与报告时限的法定报告文书
definition_en: The statutory form recording patient details, diagnosis and reporting time for a notifiable disease.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；病历书写基本规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 首位接诊医师负责完成诊疗与报告、不得推诿的制度
definition_en: A system requiring the first clinician seeing a patient to complete care and reporting without shifting responsibility.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；病历书写基本规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 向卫生行政部门与疾控机构报告疫情信息的法定行为
definition_en: The statutory act of reporting epidemic information to health authorities and disease control agencies.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 无新发病例时仍须按周期报告为零的制度
definition_en: A system requiring a periodic report of zero cases when no new cases have occurred.
source_file: 国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 超过法定时限才完成报告的行为，属违规
definition_en: Reporting a notifiable disease after the legal time limit has passed.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 应报告的病例未报告、造成数据缺失的行为
definition_en: Failure to report a case that should have been reported, leaving the data incomplete.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 故意隐瞒疫情不报告的行为，属违法行为
definition_en: The deliberate hiding of cases from reporting, which is unlawful.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 故意报告虚假疫情信息的行为，属违法行为
definition_en: The deliberate reporting of false epidemic information that misleads control efforts.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

zh: 突发公共卫生事件报告
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 发生突发公共卫生事件后按规定层级和时限上报的程序
definition_en: The procedure for reporting a public health emergency upward within set levels and time limits.
source_file: 国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 医疗机构内具体负责疫情报告与审核的人员
definition_en: The staff member in a medical institution responsible for submitting and reviewing case reports.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；病历书写基本规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 承担传染病监测、流调与疫情处置的公共卫生机构
definition_en: A public health agency responsible for disease surveillance, investigation and outbreak response.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对病例的感染来源、传播途径与接触人群进行的系统调查
definition_en: A systematic investigation of a case's source of infection, transmission route and contacts.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 调查人员到病区或社区实地开展的流行病学调查
definition_en: An epidemiological investigation carried out on site in a ward or community.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 发病前的接触史、旅行史与聚集史等流行病学信息
definition_en: Information on contact, travel and clustering in the period before illness onset.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；病历书写基本规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 病例在传染期内到过的场所与时间记录
definition_en: A record of the places and times a case visited during the infectious period.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 在重点场所与人群中主动查找未发现病例的过程
definition_en: The process of actively looking for undetected cases in key settings and groups.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对高风险人群开展检测以发现无症状感染者的措施
definition_en: Testing groups at high risk in order to detect asymptomatic infections early.
source_file: 国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 采集咽拭子等标本用于核酸检测的操作
definition_en: Collecting specimens such as throat swabs for nucleic acid testing.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；医疗机构临床检验项目目录

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 检测病原体核酸以判断是否感染的实验室方法
definition_en: A laboratory method that detects pathogen nucleic acid to determine infection.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；医疗机构临床检验项目目录

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 记录病例流行病学信息的标准化调查表格
definition_en: A standardized form recording the epidemiological information of a case.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；病历书写基本规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 从感染病原体到出现症状的时间间隔
definition_en: The interval between infection with a pathogen and the appearance of symptoms.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 病例能够将病原体传播给他人的时间段
definition_en: The period during which a case can transmit the pathogen to others.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 体内有病原体生存繁殖并能排出体外的人或动物
definition_en: A person or animal in which a pathogen lives, multiplies and can be shed.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 病原体从传染源到易感者的传播方式
definition_en: The way a pathogen passes from a source to a susceptible person.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对某种传染病缺乏免疫力、容易被感染的人群
definition_en: People who lack immunity to an infectious disease and are easily infected.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 无免疫干预时一个病例平均可传染的人数
definition_en: The average number of people one case infects in a population with no immunity or interventions.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 与确诊病例在无有效防护下近距离接触、有感染风险的人
definition_en: A person who had close contact with a confirmed case without effective protection and is at risk of infection.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 根据接触时间、距离与防护情况确定密切接触者的过程
definition_en: The process of deciding who qualifies as a close contact based on time, distance and protection.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 与密切接触者有近距离接触、存在潜在风险的人
definition_en: A person who had close contact with a close contact and carries potential risk.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 与病例有接触但未达到密切接触标准的其他人员
definition_en: Others who had contact with a case but did not meet the close contact criteria.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 查找并登记病例接触人群以阻断传播的工作
definition_en: The work of finding and registering a case's contacts to interrupt transmission.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对接触者实施隔离、检测与健康监测的综合措施
definition_en: The combined measures of isolation, testing and health monitoring applied to contacts.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 与病例接触的起止时间与累计时长
definition_en: The start, end and total duration of contact with a case.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 与病例接触时的距离、环境与防护状态
definition_en: The distance, setting and protection status when contact with the case occurred.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 记录接触者身份、联系方式与接触情况的工作
definition_en: Recording the identity, contact details and exposure details of contacts.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；病历书写基本规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 向其他地区发出协助查找接触者的正式通知
definition_en: A formal notice asking another region to help locate contacts.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 与病例在同一时段同一区域活动、存在暴露风险的人
definition_en: A person who was in the same area at the same time as a case and may have been exposed.
source_file: 国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 根据暴露情况判定需要管控或检测的人员
definition_en: A person judged to need control measures or testing because of exposure.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 感染或传播风险较高、需优先监测与干预的人群
definition_en: Groups at higher risk of infection or transmission who need priority surveillance and intervention.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对密切接触者采集标本进行检测的措施
definition_en: Collecting specimens from close contacts so that they can be tested.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；医疗机构临床检验项目目录

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对接触者每日测量体温并询问症状的观察措施
definition_en: Daily temperature checks and symptom inquiry for contacts under observation.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 向接触者说明暴露情况与防控要求的沟通工作
definition_en: Informing contacts about their exposure and the required control measures.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 将传染源与易感人群分开、防止病原体扩散的措施
definition_en: Separating sources of infection from susceptible people to prevent transmission.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对接触者或可疑人员在一定期限内进行健康监测的措施
definition_en: Health monitoring of contacts or persons under suspicion for a set period.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 在自住场所单独居住、减少与家人接触的隔离方式
definition_en: Isolation at home in a separate room with limited contact with household members.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 在政府指定场所统一实施的隔离医学观察
definition_en: Quarantine and medical observation carried out in facilities designated by the government.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 用于收治传染病患者、具备隔离条件的病房
definition_en: A ward equipped to admit patients with infectious diseases under isolation conditions.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 气压低于外部、空气只能单向排出并经过滤的隔离病房
definition_en: An isolation room kept at lower air pressure so air flows inward and is filtered before release.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 将患者单独安置于一间病房以减少交叉感染的隔离方式
definition_en: Placing a patient alone in one room to reduce cross-infection.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 达到解除标准后终止隔离措施的决定
definition_en: The decision to end isolation once release criteria are met.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 法律规定或方案要求的隔离持续时间
definition_en: The duration of isolation required by law or by the response plan.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 在隔离条件下对传染病患者实施的治疗
definition_en: Treatment of a patient with an infectious disease under isolation conditions.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对拒绝或擅自脱离隔离治疗的甲类传染病患者依法采取的强制措施
definition_en: A lawful measure applied to Class A patients who refuse or leave isolation treatment.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对接触者实施医学观察的法定或方案规定期限
definition_en: The period set by law or protocol for medical observation of contacts.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 在住所内自行监测体温与症状、非必要不外出的管理方式
definition_en: Self-monitoring of temperature and symptoms at home with no non-essential outings.
source_file: 国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 政府设置用于集中隔离医学观察的场所
definition_en: A site designated by the government for centralized quarantine and medical observation.
source_file: 国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 从发现到收治全程专人专车、不与外界接触的转运方式
definition_en: Transfer with dedicated staff and vehicle from detection to admission, without outside contact.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 观察期满且无异常后终止医学观察的决定
definition_en: The decision to end medical observation after the period ends without abnormalities.
source_file: 中华人民共和国传染病防治法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 为阻断病原体传播而穿戴的口罩、手套、防护服等装备
definition_en: Equipment such as masks, gloves and gowns worn to block pathogen transmission.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范；中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 适用于普通门诊与预检分诊的基础防护级别
definition_en: The basic protection level for general outpatient areas and triage.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 适用于发热门诊与隔离病区的加强防护级别
definition_en: The enhanced protection level for fever clinics and isolation wards.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 适用于气管插管等产生气溶胶操作的最高防护级别
definition_en: The highest protection level for aerosol-generating procedures such as intubation.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范；中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 阻隔飞沫、用于常规诊疗与呼吸道礼仪的口罩
definition_en: A mask that blocks droplets, used in routine care and respiratory hygiene.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 过滤效率高、密合性好的防护口罩，用于空气传播防护
definition_en: A high-efficiency, well-sealed respirator worn to protect against airborne pathogens.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范；中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 覆盖全身、防止体液与飞沫污染的连体防护服装
definition_en: A full-body garment that prevents contamination by body fluids and droplets.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 防止飞沫与体液溅入眼部的防护眼镜
definition_en: Protective eyewear that keeps droplets and body fluids out of the eyes.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 覆盖整个面部的透明防护挡板，防飞沫喷溅
definition_en: A clear shield covering the face that blocks droplet splashes.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 防止手部接触污染、需一人一换的手套
definition_en: Gloves that protect hands from contamination and must be changed between patients.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 通过洗手或手消毒保持手部清洁、切断接触传播的措施
definition_en: Cleaning hands by washing or disinfection to interrupt contact transmission.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

en: donning and doffing of protective clothing
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 按规范顺序穿戴与脱下防护服的操作过程
definition_en: The process of putting on and removing protective clothing in the correct sequence.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 病区出口处专用于脱除防护用品的区域
definition_en: A designated area at the ward exit for removing protective equipment.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 佩戴口罩后检查边缘是否漏气的步骤
definition_en: The step of checking a mask for leaks around its edges after putting it on.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 咳嗽打喷嚏时掩住口鼻、戴口罩并洗手的行为规范
definition_en: Behaviour such as covering the mouth when coughing and wearing a mask to reduce spread.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范；中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 接触隔离患者时穿着的、防止污染工作服的长袍
definition_en: A gown worn when caring for isolated patients to protect uniforms from contamination.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 用化学或物理方法杀灭物体上病原微生物的处理
definition_en: Treatment with chemical or physical methods that kills pathogenic microorganisms on objects.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 杀灭一切微生物包括细菌芽孢的处理方法
definition_en: A process that kills all microorganisms, including bacterial spores, on an item.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 传染源离开后对其所在场所进行的彻底消毒
definition_en: Thorough disinfection of a site after the source of infection has left.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范；中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 传染源仍在时对其排泄物与污染物进行的即时消毒
definition_en: Ongoing disinfection of excretions and contaminated items while the source is still present.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范；中华人民共和国传染病防治法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 未发现传染源时对可能受污染场所的常规消毒
definition_en: Routine disinfection of potentially contaminated sites when no source has been identified.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 以次氯酸钠等为主要成分、用于物表与污染物消毒的制剂
definition_en: A disinfectant based on sodium hypochlorite used for surfaces and contaminated items.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 以乙醇为主要成分、用于皮肤与小物件擦拭消毒的制剂
definition_en: A disinfectant containing ethanol for skin and small-item wipe disinfection.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 用紫外线照射空气或物表杀灭病原体的方法
definition_en: Using ultraviolet light to kill pathogens in air or on surfaces.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 在高压高温饱和蒸汽下杀灭全部微生物的灭菌方法
definition_en: Sterilization with saturated steam under high pressure and temperature that kills all microorganisms.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 消毒液中有效成分的含量，决定消毒效果与安全性
definition_en: The content of active ingredient in a disinfectant solution, which determines efficacy and safety.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 消毒剂与病原体接触并发挥作用所需的时间
definition_en: The time a disinfectant must remain in contact with pathogens to be effective.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对床栏、门把手等高频接触表面进行的消毒
definition_en: Disinfection of frequently touched surfaces such as bed rails and door handles.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 通过通风、紫外线或消毒设备降低空气中病原体浓度
definition_en: Reducing pathogen levels in the air by ventilation, ultraviolet light or disinfection devices.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 医疗机构产生的具有感染性或其他危害的废弃物
definition_en: Waste generated by medical facilities that is infectious or otherwise hazardous.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 携带病原体、具有感染风险的医疗废物类别
definition_en: A category of medical waste that carries pathogens and poses an infection risk.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 通过采样与检测评价消毒是否达到要求的工作
definition_en: Sampling and testing to evaluate whether disinfection meets the required standard.
source_file: 医院感染管理办法与消毒技术规范

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 将疫苗注入人体使机体产生特异性免疫的预防措施
definition_en: Administering a vaccine to induce specific immunity and prevent disease.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 国家按计划组织实施疫苗接种的公共卫生制度
definition_en: The public health system under which vaccinations are organised and delivered nationally.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 规定疫苗剂次、间隔与年龄的接种时间安排
definition_en: The timing of vaccine doses, intervals and ages set out in a schedule.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 用被杀死的病原体制成、安全性较高的疫苗
definition_en: A vaccine made from killed pathogens with a good safety profile.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法；药品说明书（国家药监局核准）

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 用减弱毒力的活病原体制成、免疫效果持久的疫苗
definition_en: A vaccine made from weakened live pathogens that gives long-lasting immunity.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法；药品说明书（国家药监局核准）

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 用基因工程表达的病原体蛋白制成的疫苗
definition_en: A vaccine made from pathogen proteins produced by genetic engineering.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法；药品说明书（国家药监局核准）

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 将编码抗原的信使核糖核酸递送入体细胞、诱导免疫应答的疫苗
definition_en: A vaccine that delivers messenger RNA encoding an antigen into cells to induce an immune response.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法；药品说明书（国家药监局核准）

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 用改造过的病毒载体递送抗原基因的疫苗
definition_en: A vaccine that uses a modified virus to deliver an antigen gene.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法；药品说明书（国家药监局核准）

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 单次接种给予的疫苗体积或抗原含量
definition_en: The volume or antigen content of vaccine given in a single administration.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法；药品说明书（国家药监局核准）

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 因发热或急性病等原因推迟接种的处理
definition_en: Postponing vaccination because of fever or an acute illness, with a new appointment.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 基础免疫后额外接种以提升抗体水平的剂次
definition_en: An extra dose after primary immunization that raises antibody levels.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 足够比例人群获得免疫后间接保护易感者的状态
definition_en: A state in which enough people are immune to indirectly protect those who are susceptible.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 临床试验中疫苗降低发病风险的程度
definition_en: The degree to which a vaccine reduces disease risk in clinical trials.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 目标人群中已完成全程接种的人数所占的比例
definition_en: The proportion of a target population that has completed vaccination.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 记录受种者疫苗接种信息的法定凭证
definition_en: The statutory booklet that records a person's complete vaccination history.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 疫情发生时对重点人群紧急开展的疫苗接种
definition_en: Vaccination carried out urgently for key groups during an outbreak.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法；国家突发公共卫生事件应急预案

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 接种合格疫苗后发生的与接种目的无关的有害反应
definition_en: A harmful reaction after vaccination with a qualified vaccine that is unrelated to the intended effect.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

zh: 疑似预防接种异常反应
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 接种后发生的怀疑与疫苗有关的健康事件，需调查判定
definition_en: A health event after vaccination suspected to be related to the vaccine and requiring investigation.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 接种后常见的轻微局部或全身反应，多可自行缓解
definition_en: A common mild local or systemic reaction after vaccination that usually resolves on its own.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 合格疫苗规范接种后造成机体组织器官损害的严重反应
definition_en: A serious reaction causing organ or tissue damage after proper vaccination with a qualified vaccine.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 注射局部出现的发红与肿胀，常见于接种后一两天
definition_en: Redness and swelling at the injection site, common in the first day or two after vaccination.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 接种后出现的发热、乏力、头痛等全身性表现
definition_en: General symptoms such as fever, fatigue and headache after vaccination.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 接种后短时间发生的严重过敏反应，需立即抢救
definition_en: A severe allergic reaction occurring shortly after vaccination that requires immediate resuscitation.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法；药品说明书（国家药监局核准）

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 因紧张或疼痛在注射时出现的短暂意识丧失
definition_en: A brief loss of consciousness during injection caused by anxiety or pain.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 仅出现在接种部位的疼痛、红肿或硬结
definition_en: Pain, redness or induration limited to the injection site after vaccination.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 系统收集、分析并评价接种后不良反应的工作
definition_en: The systematic collection, analysis and evaluation of reactions after vaccination.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 判断不良事件与疫苗之间是否存在因果关系的评估
definition_en: The assessment of whether a causal link exists between an adverse event and a vaccine.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 对经认定属于异常反应的受种者依法给予的经济补偿
definition_en: Statutory financial compensation for those with a confirmed abnormal vaccination reaction.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 接种单位按规定上报不良反应个案的制度
definition_en: The system under which vaccination units report individual adverse reactions.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
definition_zh: 接种完成后在接种点停留观察三十分钟的措施
definition_en: Staying at the vaccination site for thirty minutes after injection for observation.
source_file: 中华人民共和国疫苗管理法

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急
